test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: To which of the following Gharanas did Hindustani Classical Vocalist, Bhimsen Joshi belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana Gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhimsen Joshi **belonged to the **Kirana Gharana**, a prominent **school of Hindustani classical music**.
 
• The **Kirana Gharana **is known for its emphasis on intricate **melodic patterns**, **slow and meditative style**, and use of the** 'gayaki ang' **or **singing style**.
 
• **Bhimsen Joshi's** music was shaped by the **teachings of his guru, Sawai Gandharva**, who was also **associated** with the** Kirana Gharana**.
 
• **Joshi's** rendition of **classical ragas** and **devotional compositions** showcased the aesthetic of the **Kirana Gharana**.
 
• His performances earned him **acclaim as one of the greatest vocalists in Indian classical music**.
 
• His legacy continues to **inspire aspiring musicians** and **enthusiasts** of **classical music worldwide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agra Gharana**

 
 
• Emerged in the city of **Agra, Uttar Pradesh**, in **medieval Northern India**.
 
• **Established** by **Haji Sujan Khan**, a **court musician** of **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan**.
 
• Has significantly impacted **Hindustani classical music**, **particularly vocal styles**.
 
• Includes **Faiyaz Khan**, **Vilayat Hussain Khan**, **Khadim Hussain Khan**, and **Sharafat Hussain Khan**.
 
 
 
• **Rampur Sahaswan Gharana**
 
 
• **Founded **in the princely state of **Rampur, Uttar Pradesh**, in the **19th century**.
 
• **Established** by **Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan** and **Ustad Mehboob Khan**, c**ourt musicians** of **Rampur**.
 
• Known for i**ntricate melodic patterns**, **rhythmic improvisations**, and **systematic presentation of ragas**.
 
• Includes **Ustad Mushtaq Hussain Khan**, **Ustad Nissar Hussain Khan**, and **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan**.
 
 
 
• **Gwalior Gharana**
 
 
• Emerged in **Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India**.
 
• **Established **by **musicians patronized** by the **Scindia dynasty rulers**.
 
• Includes **Ustad Haddu Khan**, **Ustad Nathu Khan**, **Ustad Hassu Khan**, and **Pandit Vinayak Rao Patwardhan**.
 
• Profound impact on **Hindustani classical music,** particularly **vocal styles and compositions**.
